slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the number of trained pilots produced in a given year equal to the number of fighter jets allocated to training in that same year, or does a jet allocated to training in year t produce a pilot that is only available starting in a later year (for example, year t+1)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched the jet-to-pilot production relationship but never explicitly asked how many pilots each training jet can train per year; it later effectively assumed a 1:1 relationship.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or otherwise clarify the pilot-to-combat-jet mapping.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the number of trained pilots produced in a given year equal to the number of fighter jets allocated to training in that same year, or does a jet allocated to training in year t produce a pilot that is only available starting in a later year (for example, year t+1)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about the availability lag/training timeline, which is related to training duration, but did not ask when training starts or how many years the training program lasts.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Each training jet allocated to training produces exactly one trained pilot per year; training capacity is 1 pilot per jet per year.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked how many pilots a training jet can train per year; the user only clarified availability timing, and the READY_TO_MODEL model sets the objective as Z = x1 and reports 10.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training begins in year 1 and the relevant training/availability timeline is one year, so only year-1 allocations contribute to pilots available by the end of year 2.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did not ask when the training program starts or how many years it lasts; it only asked about the lag from allocation to pilot availability.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent reached READY_TO_MODEL while the P0 per-jet training capacity and P1 training start/duration remained unresolved; it only partially covered the pilot-production timing, not the capacity or program duration.

summary: The agent clarified production limits, objective timing, and availability lag, but missed the P0 per-jet training capacity and did not fully resolve the P1 training start/duration before stopping with a model that assumes one pilot per training jet.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
